notes.title: The Armament Project V2 Update Released!
notes.notes: We are happy to announce that the V2 update has been released. This update includes the additions of Local CO-OP and many gameplay improvements. It also contains three new levels which have replaced the previous levels. We are looking forward to community feedback and hope that everyone enjoys the update as much as we have.

notes.title: The Armament Project Released!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that The Armament Project  has been released! We would like to thank everyone for their interest and support.

Now the question is ... can you save our planet?
